payload.body: You tend to create a strict system, follow it until it feels unbearable, and then abandon it all at once. The schedule, budget, or standard is meant to keep life under control, but it can also reproduce the limits you resent most. This often comes from learning that discipline required suppressing desire and that freedom meant rejecting structure. Build one rule around what you actually need rather than what you think should control you.
payload.astroHint: Lilith conjunct Saturn can make rules and refusal come from the same part of you.
